statements.text: The shown error, built-in or error-text, is linked to the native input as its description after supporting-text, so it is read when the field is focused.

events.description: Emitted when the time value is committed.
events.name: change

events.description: Emitted when the time value changes while editing.
events.name: input

examples.html:
<form style="max-inline-size: 20rem;">
                <violet-time-picker disabled error-text label="Start time" max="21:00" min="06:00" name="start-time" size="natural" step="60" supporting-text="This schedule is inherited from the greenhouse template." value="09:30"></violet-time-picker>
            </form>

<form style="max-inline-size: 20rem;">
                <violet-time-picker error-text="Please choose a time." invalid label="Start time" max="21:00" min="06:00" name="start-time" required size="natural" step="60" supporting-text="Choose when this automation should begin each day." value></violet-time-picker>
            </form>

<form style="max-inline-size: 20rem;">
                <violet-time-picker error-text label="Start time" max="21:00" min="06:00" name="start-time" size="natural" step="60" supporting-text="Choose when this automation should begin each day." value="09:30"></violet-time-picker>
            </form>

summary: Time-of-day field wrapping the native time input, with a label, supporting text and range checks; the value is a 24-hour time string.

usage.text: value is a 24-hour "HH:MM" or "HH:MM:SS" string whatever the display format, and the form receives it under name. Any other string is invalid with "Enter a valid time."
step is in seconds, default 60, so only hours and minutes are edited. Use step="1" to edit seconds, or e.g. 900 for 15-minute arrow-key steps.
min and max are times within one day; a value outside them is invalid with "Choose a time at or after/before ...". A range that crosses midnight is not supported.
input and change carry detail.value. The native input's own input event also reaches host listeners, without detail; skip events that have none.
